test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We're asking them to ______ the deadline.
solution: The correct answer is **extend**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate option to fill in the blank in " *We're asking them to ______ the deadline*." is extend, • We're asking them to extend the deadline.*​* • **Extend - **Cause to cover a wider area; make larger.** (**एक व्यापक क्षेत्र को कवर करने का कारण; बड़ा करना।**)** • *For example : "The garden has been extended."* • *​*Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's discuss information about other options: • **Increase - **Become or make greater in size, amount, or degree. (आकार, राशि या डिग्री में बड़ा होना या बनाना।)** ** • **​***For example : "They are aiming to increase awareness of social issues."* • **Enlarge - **Make or become larger or more extensive. (बड़ा या अधिक व्यापक बनाना या बनना) • **​***For example : "They have renovated and enlarged the four-storey building."* • **Broaden - **Become larger in distance from side to side or widen. (अगल-बगल से दूरी में बड़ा हो या चौड़ा हो।) • **​***For example : "Her smile broadened after seeing her mom."* 32:Tcb5, The correct answer is '**Breach**'.
